name: Gold & Silver Horn Kings
tag: Borrowed Suffering · Boys Descend to Earth
wound: Examiner props preparing with portrait posters; after turning to water, their souls were reclaimed by Laojun
desc: Guanyin borrowed them from Taishang Laojun three times, transforming them into demons to test the pilgrimage team's resolve. Borrowed suffering, borrowed people.

name: Sai Taisui
tag: Stole the Purple-Gold Bell · Refusing to Be Ridden · A Quiet Demon
wound: Bit through the iron chain · A neck that stopped hurting for three years · Wore the Purple-Gold Bell at his waist as an ID
desc: The Golden-Haired Hou bit through the iron chain beneath Guanyin's lotus throne, snatched the Purple-Gold Bell, seized the Lady, and shut himself away for three years. What he stole was not the bell but the right not to be ridden.

name: Golden Sage Lady
fate: Returned home wearing the brown robe
tag: The One in the Brown Robe · Gender Victim
wound: Three years in the brown robe · Tactile amnesia · Internalizing a three-zhang distance
desc: Immortal Ziyang gifted her the brown robe to protect her chastity, yet it also stripped away her right to consent. For three years she could not touch her own face. The barbs fell away, but the tactile nerves had not yet awakened.

name: Chen Village Boy & Girl
tag: Offerings to the King of Spiritual Inspiration · Tears Crystallized into Salt
wound: Nine years of offerings · Eighteen children's lives · All the village's realgar from the same hands
desc: The King of Spiritual Inspiration of the Tongtian River (a goldfish from Guanyin's lotus pond) demanded a boy and a girl each year. Nine years of cost crystallized into salt, seeping into the village's foundation.
